image_description: A live concert performance on a brightly lit stage. The scene features multiple musicians, including a guitarist in the foreground left and another musician center-right, illuminated by intense red and green stage lighting beams. The stage floor is reflective, showing strong red highlights. Several black stage monitors (speakers) are arranged along the front edge of the stage. In the background, there is a drum kit and other band members partially visible in shadow. The atmosphere is energetic with visible light rays cutting through haze.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The reflection of the red light on the floor is extremely uniform and saturated, lacking the subtle micro-variations of real-world polished surfaces. It has a slight 'plastic' or digitally smoothed appearance.

There is a mix of motion blur and depth-of-field blur that feels slightly inconsistent. Some background elements dissolve into noise/paint-like textures rather than optical blur, particularly around the drum kit area.

The fingers on the fretboard of the guitar on the left are indistinct and seem to merge with the neck. The geometry of the hand holding the pick is also vague, suggesting minor anatomical fusion common in AI generations.
